holder-quote: Tkrn was uh, politely, average for his level and age. Which meant he was a Level 16 [Guard]. Not exactly impressive. His best Skill?
effect-quote: It meant he performed the Skill…fast.

holder-quote: The Gnoll in front of him took a swing as Tkrn’s head turned. The [Guardsman] was ready for this, though.
effect-quote: The Gnoll’s fist never reached him. He went over backwards with a shout of surprise as Tkrn moved.
He wasn’t a good killer—but he was used to bar brawls and tripping up people, holding a point.
